slice.notes: Confirmed First Avenue Seventh–St. Marks and St. Marks Second–Avenue A, plus preserved Seventh and prior context. Dated observations and authored estimates; no measured survey or calibrated acceptance. Original game export preserved. P01 adds only 137–143 First Avenue west faces and a bounded First Avenue continuation; Ninth and other avenue ends remain closed. P02 adds five east-side First Avenue faces only; Ninth return is deferred, with its plain shared mass explicit. P03 adds only 145 First Avenue and its complete southwest Ninth return. The supporting Ninth stub ends at x=-40; no other Ninth facade is assigned. N01A supersedes the P03 road stub with access to four north Ninth faces, west terminal x=-69. Unassigned 147 First face and other Ninth faces remain deferred.
